author: Sophocles
title: Oedipus King of Thebes
edition: London: George Allen & Unwin Ltd., Fourteenth Thousand, July 1917 reprint; Gilbert Murray’s English rhyming-verse translation first published February 1911. Project Gutenberg 27673 retains this title/imprint and reprint table. Only the play, including this edition’s speaker labels and stage directions, is supplied; preface, argument, notes and digital boilerplate excluded. Page markers removed; verse lines and indentation retained from the source HTML; prose whitespace collapsed. The library text is the whole play, from its title and opening scene direction to the final stage direction; the title page, reprint table, Preface, list of characters, Argument, scene-division rules and Murray's Notes are omitted. Each speech, opened by its centred speaker label or entrance, is one stanza block; the transcription's verse indentation is kept as that many spaces per indentation step (the two lines set at one and a half steps are flush left), and stage directions wrapped across source lines keep those line breaks.

rights.basis: The supplied English translation first appeared in 1911; its identified Fourteenth Thousand witness has a July 1917 final reprint entry. Both translation and witness were published before 1931. Project Gutenberg explicitly records public-domain status in the USA.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg HTML (pglaf mirror of ebook 27673, pg27673-images.html), converted with a scratch script: kept the source from the play heading OEDIPUS, KING OF THEBES up to the NOTES heading; removed page-number spans with their verse ranges; the opening scene paragraph became a paragraph with whitespace collapsed; inside the verse division every source line became a verse line, prefixed with N spaces for an iN indentation class, a new stanza block beginning at every centred (ia) line; strophe labels and emphasis kept as plain text; blank lines and rules dropped.
